name: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 2
source:
Taking place 100 years after the first game, the country of Kyou is in turmoil because of a power struggle going on between the emperor and the retired emperor, and the people of Kyou are falling into desperation, fearing the coming of the end of the world. Karin, a modern-day high school girl, is summoned to be the Priestess of the Dragon God who will save Kyou. However, there is a priestess who has been recognized by the retired emperor, and the eight men chosen as Karin's Hachijou (her bodyguards) do not believe that Karin is really the priestess.

[edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_2]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在前作的一百年後。由於天皇與上皇之間爆發權力鬥爭，京之國陷入動盪，京的百姓也因畏懼末日降臨而逐漸絕望。現代女高中生花梨被召喚到這個世界，成為拯救京的龍神神子。然而，上皇已經承認了另一位神子，就連被選為「八葉」、負責守護花梨的八名男子，也不相信她是真正的神子。

[改寫自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_2]Wikipedia[/url]]
